name: The grand world (everything on, extra large)
description: Every optional feature at once in a 512 x 512 world: continents and seas, seasons with weather fronts and harsh and mild years, a slow warming and cooling of the climate over 150,000 ticks, random ice ages, droughts and meteors, wildfires, storms, floods, volcanoes, plant blights, outbreaks and good years (all at mild settings), overgrazing (softened: grazed-out ground regrows at no less than 45% of normal speed), fouled ground and erosion of bare soil, three kinds of plant, brains with memory, a sense of home (the best feeding place remembered) and chemical signals that also act on the body, fast-adapting disease that spreads (sickness doubles upkeep; immunity follows), camouflage, aging, litter size, torpor, tolerance of relatives, food sharing, luck at birth, and cells that can bond into colonies with specialized cells. Sex is a gene: harmful mutations pile up in lines that never mix (the textbook Muller's ratchet, with a 50% chance of each inherited one being repaired, so the load levels off near 6), mate-seekers that wait too long split in two instead, any well-fed neighbor can be a mate, and the first generation has a full spread of mate-seeking. Plants grow at 3 times the standard rate (0.24). Nutrients travel through food (animals carry a nutrient store; plants on poor soil are poor food), every baby mutates at least a little (a mutation-rate floor of 0.01), and now and then a few genes jump by a lot at once (rare big mutations). Together these nearly double the species alive and give a lasting second feeding level of mixed eaters (Phase 9 audit, stages 3 and 4). A fat reserve banks only true surplus (from the breeding level up), is drawn on in lean spells, is half handed to young, and pays for breeding (Phase 9 fat rework). Animals never attack their own parent or young, meat keeps in the cold, and heat and cold cost half what they did. With these the grand world has about 2.4 times the species, 72% more diversity, a bigger population with twice the low point, and twice the meat in the diet (16 seeds, 500,000 ticks; devlog 21). Lasting meat-eating groups still do not evolve here: see the Grand world: hunters preset. Nothing here is fully tuned: watch the births-with-two-parents readout and the mate-seeking trait chart.
